limitations: Player-seasons are repeated observations; intervals below are descriptive binomial intervals, not player-cluster inference.
Same-season ISO and wOBA overlap the endpoint and are diagnostic ceilings, ineligible for model promotion. xSLG is an outcome proxy.
Qualified selection excludes players who lost playing time. Forecasts condition on next-year 200+ PA; attrition is not scored as failure.
No independent post-2026 temporal confirmation; no selection of a new winning model from reused test results.
HR 20/25/30 and OPS endpoints unavailable in the frozen 19-column source. wRC+ unavailable. EV90, maxEV, Pull-Air and raw launch-angle panel absent.
Additive spline logistic is a GAM-like model, not a separately tuned GAM. Three-way interactions deferred until stronger evidence and clustered validation.
MiLB-to-MLB developmental outcomes, age/level/park adjustments and historical maturation paths are not validated.
No universal frontier is established. No current rankings, grades, trade values, recommendations or Decision Lab inputs change.
